event_chain.summary: Account used to send phishing in chief name

summary: In late September 2026 the email account of Aliquippa (Pennsylvania) Police Chief John Lane was hacked and used to send fraudulent phishing emails asking recipients to review attached documents. On September 30, 2026 the department publicly confirmed the account had been hacked and the chief did not send the messages, and warned recipients not to open attachments, click links or share personal or financial information. Duquesne Police Chief Tom Shaw's account was compromised in a similar way (coded separately under issue #24414).
